arxiv-2005-09069.title: P-SIF : Document Embeddings Using Partition Averaging
arxiv-2005-09069.creator: Vivek Gupta, Ankit Saw, Pegah Nokhiz, Praneeth Netrapalli, Piyush Rai, Partha Talukdar
arxiv-2005-09069.description: Abstract Simple weighted averaging of word vectors often yields effective representations for sentences which outperform sophisticated seq2seq neural models in many tasks. While it is desirable to use the same method to represent documents as well, unfortunately, the effectiveness is lost when representing long documents involving multiple sentences.

arxiv-2106-01243.title: Study of semi-boosted top quark reconstruction performance on the line shape of a t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} resonance
arxiv-2106-01243.creator: J. Pácalt, J. Kvita
arxiv-2106-01243.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J. Pácalt, J. Kvita. We study the top quark pair events production in p ​ p pp collisions in the ℓ \ell +jets channel at the energy of s = 14 \sqrt{s}=14 TeV for Standard Model as well as new physics processes. We explore the usage of semi-boosted topologies where the top quark decays into a high-transverse momentum (boosted) hadronic W W -jet and an isolated b b -jet and study their performance in the t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} events kinematic reconstruction.

arxiv-2212-04507.title: Actinide-boosting r r Process in Black Hole–Neutron Star Merger Ejecta
arxiv-2212-04507.creator: Shinya Wanajo, Sho Fujibayashi, Kota Hayashi, Kenta Kiuchi, Yuichiro Sekiguchi, Masaru Shibata
arxiv-2212-04507.description: Abstract We examine nucleosynthesis in the ejecta of black hole–neutron star mergers based on the results of long-term neutrino-radiation-magnetohydrodynamics simulations for the first time. We find that the combination of dynamical and post-merger ejecta reproduces a solar-like r r -process pattern.

arxiv-2305-17263.title: Generation and control of non-local quantum equivalent extreme ultraviolet photons Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2305-17263.creator: Geoffrey R. Harrison, Tobias Saule, R. Esteban Goetz, George N Gibson, Anh-Thu Le, and Carlos A Trallero-Herrero *
arxiv-2305-17263.description: Abstract We present a high precision, self-referencing, common path XUV interferometer setup to produce pairs of spatially separated and independently controllable XUV pulses that are locked in phase and time. The spatial separation is created by introducing two equal but opposite wavefront tilts or using superpositions of orbital angular momentum.

arxiv-2402-01927.title: Mathemyths: Leveraging Large Language Models to Teach Mathematical Language through Child-AI Co-Creative Storytelling Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computin
arxiv-2402-01927.creator: Chao Zhang, Xuechen Liu, Katherine Ziska, Soobin Jeon, Chi-Lin Yu, Ying Xu
arxiv-2402-01927.description: Abstract . Mathematical language is a cornerstone of a child’s mathematical development, and children can effectively acquire this language through storytelling with a knowledgeable and engaging partner. In this study, we leverage the recent advances in large language models to conduct free-form, creative conversations with children.

arxiv-2409-15356.title: TCG CREST System Description for the Second DISPLACE Challenge
arxiv-2409-15356.creator: Nikhil Raghav, Subhajit Saha, Md Sahidullah, Swagatam Das
arxiv-2409-15356.description: Abstract In this report, we describe the speaker diarization (SD) and language diarization (LD) systems developed by our team for the Second DISPLACE Challenge, 2024. Our contributions were dedicated to Track 1 for SD and Track 2 for LD in multilingual and multi-speaker scenarios.

arxiv-2507-00766.title: A tableaux formula for q q -rook numbers
arxiv-2507-00766.creator: Tirtharaj Basu, Aritra Bhattacharya
arxiv-2507-00766.description: Abstract . We provide a formula for the Garsia-Remmel q q -rook numbers as a sum over standard Young tableaux. We connect our formula with the coefficients in q q -Whittaker expansion of unicellular LLT functions. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 05E05; Secondary: 05A10, 05A30 1.

arxiv-2507-08461.title: Bi-Contextuality: A Novel Non-Classical Phenomenon in Bipartite Quantum Systems
arxiv-2507-08461.creator: Gabriel Ruffolo, Nigel Benjamin Lee Junsheng, Kim Mu Young, Dzmitry Matsukevich, Rafael Rabelo, Dagomir Kaszlikowski, Paweł Kurzyński
arxiv-2507-08461.description: Abstract We present and experimentally demonstrate a novel non-classical phenomenon, bi-contextuality, observed in quantum systems prepared by two independent sources. This discovery plays a key role in the developing framework of network nonlocality, offering a new method for confirming the quantum nature of measurements within a single network node.

arxiv-2510-19283.title: Error Analysis of Triangular Optimal Transport Maps for Filtering Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2510-19283.creator: Mohammad Al-Jarrah, Bamdad Hosseini, Niyizhen Jin, Michele Martino, Amirhossein Taghvaei
arxiv-2510-19283.description: Abstract We present a systematic analysis of estimation errors for a class of optimal transport based algorithms for filtering and data assimilation. Along the way, we extend previous error analyses of Brenier maps to the case of conditional Brenier maps that arise in the context of simulation based inference.

The views and conclusions contained in this document are those of the authors and should no
arxiv-2601-02596.creator: Md Abu Sayed 1 , Asif Rahman 1 ,Ahmed Hemida 2 Christopher Kiekintveld 1 , Charles Kamhoua 2
arxiv-2601-02596.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Md Abu Sayed 1 , Asif Rahman 1 ,Ahmed Hemida 2 Christopher Kiekintveld 1 , Charles Kamhoua 2. This paper explores coordinated deception strategies by synchronizing defenses across coupled cyber and physical systems to mislead attackers and strengthen defense mechanisms. We introduce a Stackelberg game framework to model the strategic interaction between defenders and attackers, where the defender leverages CVSS-based exploit probabilities and real-world vulnerability data from the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) to guide the deployment of deception.

arxiv-2602-18611.title: Combined measurements and interpretations of Higgs boson production and decay in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2602-18611.description: Abstract Combined measurements of Higgs boson production and decay rates are reported, representing the most comprehensive study performed by the CMS Collaboration to date. The included analyses use proton-proton collision data recorded by the CMS experiment at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV from 2016 to 2018, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 ​ \fbinv 138\fbinv .

pmc-10590663.title: Towards two decades of Atlantic Ocean mass and heat transports at 26.5° N
pmc-10590663.creator: William E. Johns, Shane Elipot, David A. Smeed, Ben Moat, Brian King, Denis L. Volkov, Ryan H. Smith
pmc-10590663.description: Continuous measurements of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC) and meridional ocean heat transport at 26.5° N began in April 2004 and are currently available through December 2020. Approximately 90% of the total meridional heat transport (MHT) at 26.5° N is carried by the zonally averaged overturning circulation, and an even larger fraction of the heat transport variability (approx.

pmc-12416394.title: Determination of the 90% Effective Dose of Remimazolam Continuous Infusion for Preventing Emergence Delirium in Pediatric Patients Undergoing Adenoidectomy or Adenotonsillectomy with Sevoflurane: A Biased Coin Up-and-Down Sequential Trial Design
pmc-12416394.creator: Zhong-Sai Yang, Ding Li, Yu Jiang, Fei Xiao, Hai-Ya Yan
pmc-12416394.description: BackgroundEmergence delirium (ED) is a common postoperative complication during the recovery period in pediatric anesthesia. Continuous intravenous infusion of remimazolam can effectively prevent the occurrence of ED. However, the optimal dose for preventing ED in pediatric patients remains unclear. This study aimed to determine the 90% effective dose (ED90) of remimazolam during continuous infusion for preventing ED in children.

pmc-12441758.title: Application of Open‐Source Digital Resources for 3D Visualization of Clustered Transcriptomic Data
pmc-12441758.creator: Hunter F. Strickland, Andrew Shen, Anna‐Lisa Paul, Robert Ferl
pmc-12441758.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). As datasets grow in size with the increased accessibility of high‐throughput transcriptome sequencing, methods of dimensionality reduction have become invaluable for data analysis. The methods of dimensionality reduction, including t‐distributed stochastic neighbor embedding or Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection, are utilized to create figures and projections of the high‐dimensional data into a set of lower dimensions, 2D or 3D, which are more well‐suited for human comprehension. These methods of dimensionality reduction have continually grown in popularity and widespread use.

pmc-12467710.title: An Open Trial for Transdiagnostic Behavior Therapy for Primary Care (TBT-PC) in Veterans with Symptoms of Depression and Anxiety
pmc-12467710.creator: Daniel F Gros, Stephanie Hart, Michelle Pompei, Ron Acierno, Martin Drapeau
pmc-12467710.description: Transdiagnostic psychotherapies were developed to address multiple diagnostic presentations via a single, easier-to-implement protocol. However, despite advances, these protocols are largely limited to longer formats designed for mental health settings. The present study investigated a version of Transdiagnostic Behavior Therapy (TBT-PC) that was adapted for primary care settings.

pmc-12603170.description: Snakebite, a neglected tropical disease is a major cause of mortality and morbidity in India, despite which reliable nationwide data are limited. To address this, we carried out a survey in 25 districts across 11 states, covering a 60 million population.

pmc-12715853.title: Somatic mutation counts as a surrogate marker for tumor mutation burden to predict progesterone receptor-positive (PR+) status in PIK3CA-mutated breast cancer
pmc-12715853.creator: Bandana Kumari, Rijhul Lahariya
pmc-12715853.description: Objectives: Invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), the most prevalent subtype of breast cancer, is characterized by significant genomic heterogeneity. Tumor mutation burden (TMB) has emerged as a predictive biomarker for immunotherapy response, yet its estimation via whole-exome sequencing remains complex and costly.

pmc-12969315.title: Dual-function thermoresponsive antibiotic-loaded hydrogel with antimicrobial and osteogenic properties for implant-related infection control
pmc-12969315.creator: Caroline Dini, Stéfany Barbosa Alves da Cruz, Rodolfo D Piazza, Bruna E Nagay, Rodrigo FC Marques, Renato CV Casarin, Fang Yang, Magda Feres, Jet Liu, Batbileg Bor, Edilson Ervolino, Liqun Xu, Erica D de Avila, Leonardo P Faverani, João Gabriel S Souza, Jeroen JJP van den Beucken, Valentim AR Barão
pmc-12969315.description: Implant-related infections demand advanced biomaterials capable of delivering localized, sustained antimicrobial activity while supporting tissue repair. Here, we present an engineered thermoresponsive hydrogel based on poly(N-vinylcaprolactam) (PNVCL), designed as a dual-function platform that enables temperature-triggered gelation, controlled tetracycline release, and osteogenic support.

pmc-12982266.title: Sequential reagents release from layered effervescent tablets for simplifying multi-step sample preparation and extraction of metal ions from environmental samples
pmc-12982266.creator: Vasiliki Aggeli, Efthimia Toti, Dimosthenis L Giokas
pmc-12982266.description: Sample preparation typically involves multiple steps to create conditions for separating analytes from the sample matrix. These steps involve the preparation of reagents and materials, their addition into the sample, mixing by external energy input, and timing of each step. All these steps increase analysis time, reduce sample throughput, and require benchtop laboratory equipment and trained personnel.

pmc-13385981.title: Socioeconomic and Geographical Analysis on Antenatal Care Visits in Indonesia: A Cross-sectional Study
pmc-13385981.creator: Tety Rachmawati, Stefanus Supriyanto, Dede Anwar Musadad, Hari Basuki Notobroto, Yunita Fitrianti, Indah Pawitaningtyas, Arief Priyo Nugroho, Sri Handayani, Nantabah Zainul Khaqiqi, Diyan Ermawan Effendi
pmc-13385981.description: Background: Antenatal care (ANC) is crucial for reducing maternal and neonatal mortality by detecting and managing pregnancy complications. In Indonesia, a policy mandating at least six ANC visits (K6) per pregnancy has been introduced, yet factors influencing adequate ANC under this new policy remain unevaluated.

pmc-13415466.title: Investigating the efficacy of skin swabbing as a minimally invasive method of genetic sampling from Indian amphibians
pmc-13415466.creator: G Vaibhavi, C K Aravind, Shashank K Borkar, Sona M Sebastian, Pavan Kumar Thunga, G Ravikanth, K V Gururaja, Priti Hebbar
pmc-13415466.description: Amphibians are facing an unprecedented extinction crisis; 41% of the species are currently on the verge of extinction, making them among the most threatened vertebrates. One of the integral components in amphibian conservation is genetic research, which provides vital insights into their fitness and long-term persistence. Molecular studies on amphibians most often use invasive methods that are detrimental to them.

pmc-13456759.creator: Hanxiao Ma, Ziming Huang, Yapei Cui, Jiasheng Shen, Liang Zhang, Man Zeng, Xiaojuan Huang

pmc-13583453.title: 5‐Fluorouracil (5‐FU) Cardiotoxicity: A Stressful Event
pmc-13583453.creator: Yash Desai, Rohan Singh, Kush Desai, Samuel Bennett, Rohan Desai, Manu Mysore, Satabdi Datta Choudhury
pmc-13583453.description: 5‐Fluorouracil (5‐FU), a chemotherapeutic agent, is routinely used for solid tumors. Known cardiotoxic effects of 5‐FU include fatal arrhythmias, myocardial infarctions, and coronary vasospasms. This case report describes a 56‐year‐old man who had acute heart failure with cardiogenic shock suspected to be related to 5‐FU exposure; notably, cardiac dysfunction resolved following cessation of therapy.
